// CHAOS-5156: closes a gap codex round r1 on #2292 found (independently
// confirmed against real lizard 1.23.0 before fixing). stateDecToImp was
// missing the "(" branch clikeStates.stateDecToImp has (clike.go) --
// a function returning a function pointer, e.g. `int (*make(int))(int)`.
// Java has no function-pointer syntax, but JavaStates inherits
// _state_dec_to_imp UNCHANGED (confirmed from source), so lizard's
// tolerant tokenizer still parses this token shape. Measured directly
// against real lizard 1.23.0: complexity 2 (base 1 + if).
class C {
    int (*make(int x))(int y) {
        if (x > 0) {
            return 1;
        }
        return 0;
    }
}
